item.title: Tehran to host ECO heads of state summit on December 3–4
item.description: First Vice President Aref describes the gathering as an opportunity to expand regional cooperation.

item.title: Iran showcases mining, steel capabilities at Metal-Expo 2026 in St. Petersburg
item.description: Twelve major Iranian producers exhibit under a 550-square-meter national pavilion organized by IMIDRO, as Tehran's ambassador says industries damaged in the recent wars have been rebuilt.

item.title: Iran, Turkmenistan, Kazakhstan agree to launch regional digital corridor
item.description: Iran, Turkmenistan, and Kazakhstan have reached a preliminary agreement on establishing a regional digital corridor linking Central Asia to the Persian Gulf.

item.title: Qalibaf: Iran-China strategic ties must move from paper deals to operational cooperation
item.description: Iran's Special Envoy for China Affairs Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf outlined a four-pillar roadmap to deepen Tehran-Beijing ties.

item.title: Tehran, Moscow warn against US 'dangerous' plan to sabotage shipping in Caspian Sea
item.description: Tehran and Moscow have warned against a US scheme to extend anti-Iran measures into the Caspian Sea.

item.title: The rise of Iran's dairy industry through the story of Mohammad Ali Daghighi
item.description: The story of an Iranian entrepreneur whose journey from poultry farming to building a major dairy enterprise reflects decades of investment, perseverance and Iran's agricultural transformation.

item.title: Iran, Armenia ink eight-sector economic pact, elevating Norduz border to 'model gateway'
item.description: Vice President Pourmohammadi and Armenian Deputy PM Grigoryan finalize a comprehensive joint document spanning infrastructure, energy, and trade, securing Tehran's northern trade routes and neutralizing hostile transit corridors in the Caucasus.

item.title: Iran dismisses France’s ‘preposterous’ claims in fridge cyberattack incident
item.description: Iran has rejected “baseless and one-sided” accusations by the French government regarding alleged cyberattacks on European supermarkets.

item.title: Iran’s rights body condemns France’s crackdown on peaceful protesters
item.description: Iranian judiciary-affiliated human rights body condemns France’s violent crackdown on nationwide peaceful protests.

item.title: New power poles, Resistance Front to challenge US tech monopoly: Iran’s Basij chief
item.description: Hossein Taeb says the Resistance Front has fundamentally disrupted the strategy of the global arrogance to subjugate independent nations through a monopoly on cutting-edge technologies.

item.title: Iran drafting 1406 budget on ‘zero oil’ scenario to shield economy against blockade: Official
item.description: A Plan and Budget Organization official announces an emergency economic roadmap, ruling out Central Bank borrowing as domestic production neutralizes Washington’s blockade.

item.title: ‘Baseless speculations’: Iran’s FM dismisses reports of meeting between Rezaei, Vance
item.description: Araghchi ruled out any chance of a meeting between top Iranian and American officials, calling the recent reports about negotiations “baseless speculations.”

item.title: Chilean truckers begin nationwide strike over rising fuel prices
item.description: Truck drivers park their vehicles along major highways, slowing traffic on key routes to protest rising fuel prices, particularly diesel.

item.title: Pro-Palestine activists slam Israeli orchestra performance at British Library
item.description: Pro-Palestinian activists rallied outside the British Library in London, demanding a boycott of a concert featuring musicians from the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra.

item.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians during olive harvest
item.description: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians and activists accompanying them as they harvested olives in the occupied West Bank village of Qusra.
